blocks.text: Celebrity couple Barbara Palvin and Dylan Sprouse have officially become parents as they welcomed their first child, a baby girl. The pair made the announcement by sharing a photo of the three of them through their Instagram pages on Tuesday, Sept. 29. “We took Labor Day literally this year,” the caption read, apparently indicating that their baby was born last Sept. 7.
